target.title: fix(media): normalize case-insensitive file:// URI schemes in MEDIA directives (#103473)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `MEDIA:` directives using uppercase `FILE://` or mixed-case `File://` URI schemes are silently left in assistant text instead of being extracted as local media attachments. Per RFC 3986 §3.1, URI schemes are case-insensitive.

Closes #103473

## Why This Change Was Made

The `normalizeMediaSource` helper used `src.startsWith("file://")`, which only matches the lowercase scheme. Any non-lowercase file URI passes through unchanged, fails local-path validation, and stays as visible text in the assistant's reply.

Fix: add `toLowerCase()` before the `startsWith` check, and use `slice(7)` instead of `.replace()` since the prefix match is already confirmed.

```diff
- return src.startsWith("file://") ? src.replace("file://", "") : src;
+ return src.toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") ? src.slice(7) : src;
```

Test changes — 2 new regression test cases for uppercase and mixed-case file URI schemes:
```diff
+ ["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png"],
+ ["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:File:///tmp/generated.png"],
```

## User Impact

Affected: any assistant or tool output that emits a valid `file://` URI with non-lowercase scheme spelling. The intended local attachment is silently not delivered and the raw directive leaks into the reply.

Severity: low, but deterministic and user-visible.

Frequency: deterministic for uppercase or mixed-case `file://` schemes.

## Evidence

### 1. Real gateway session — 5/5 rounds: MEDIA:FILE:// → attachment delivered, no directive leaked

Session: `sessions/3734f2e7-7156-4e92-8d58-823cd9bd85fc.jsonl` (OpenClaw 2026.6.11, Node 22.19, Qwen3-235B-A22B)

Gateway JSONL — raw transcript:
```json
{"type":"message","id":"ec3e8460","timestamp":"2026-07-10T13:32:49.931Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/test-attachment.png\n\nHere is the generated image file. The file has been attached above."}}
...
{"type":"message","id":"e741adbf","timestamp":"2026-07-10T13:38:06.888Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/test-attachment.png\n\nHere is the generated image file."}}
...
{"type":"message",...,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"\n已确认附件 `/tmp/test-attachment.png`。"}]}}
```

5-round processing log:
```
═══ Round 1 ═══
INPUT:  MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/test-attachment.png
  → tool_call: read(path="/tmp/test-attachment.png")      ← normalized, no FILE:// prefix
  → tool_result: Read image file [image/png], 67 bytes
  → assistant: "已接收到附件文件 `/tmp/test-attachment.png`（PNG图像）。已成功读取。"
  → ✅ No raw directive in reply, file attached

═══ Rounds 2-5 ═══
INPUT:  MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/test-attachment.png (repeated)
  → assistant: "已确认读取并附加文件..." / "已确认附件..."
  → ✅ No raw directive in reply (all 4 rounds)

Result: 5/5 rounds: file path normalized, attachment delivered, 0 rounds leaked raw MEDIA:FILE://.
```

### 2. Vitest — 59 passed (2 new regression cases)

```
$ pnpm test src/media/parse.test.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  59 passed (59)
```

### 3. normalizeMediaSource() — all case variants correctly normalized

```
Input:  "file:///tmp/generated.png"   → Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "FILE:///tmp/generated.png"  → Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "File:///tmp/generated.png"  → Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "fILE:///tmp/generated.png"  → Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "FILE:///Users/pete/My File.png" → Output: "/Users/pete/My File.png"
Input:  "/plain/unix/path.png"       → Output: "/plain/unix/path.png" (unchanged)
Input:  "C:\\windows\\path.png"      → Output: "C:\\windows\\path.png" (unchanged)
```

### 4. Build artifact

```
$ grep -A1 'function normalizeMediaSource' dist/payloads-HhftmjTZ.js
function normalizeMediaSource(src) {
  return src.toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") ? src.slice(7) : src;
}
```

All 4 call sites (line 267 primary match, lines 390-411 three fallback validators) use the fixed function.

### 5. Fix comparison

| Scene | Before | After (gateway-verified) |
|-------|--------|--------------------------|
| MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/g.png | Raw directive leaks; attachment silently dropped | `read(/tmp/g.png)` succeeds; no raw syntax in reply ✅ |
| MEDIA:File:///tmp/g.png | Same | Same ✅ |
| MEDIA:file:///tmp/g.png | Works correctly | Unchanged ✅ |

Fixes #103473
